read_channels.notes: CO2 concentration in ppm from UART response bytes 2 (high) and 3 (low).

preconditions: Sensor powered and preheated for 3 minutes.

transaction.notes: Read 9-byte response: start byte 0xFF, command 0x86, high byte, low byte, 4 reserved, checksum.

steps.notes: Calculate CO2 = high_byte * 256 + low_byte. Verify checksum.

operation_flows.notes: Standard read operation for CO2 concentration.

preconditions: Sensor stable at 400ppm CO2 for at least 20 minutes.
Sensor stable at known span gas concentration for at least 20 minutes.

transaction.notes: Send span calibration command: 0xFF 0x01 0x88 span_high span_low 0x00 0x00 0x00 checksum. Span value in ppm (high byte, low byte).

steps.notes: Calibrate span point to specified concentration.

transaction.notes: Send self-calibration command: 0xFF 0x01 0x79 enable_byte 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x00 checksum. enable_byte = 0xA0 to enable, 0x00 to disable.
Send detection range command: 0xFF 0x01 0x99 0x00 range_byte4 range_byte3 range_byte2 range_byte1 checksum. Range value as 32-bit big-endian.

preconditions: Sensor stable at 400ppm CO2 for at least 20 minutes.

steps.notes: Pull HD pin low (0V) for at least 7 seconds.

operation_flows.notes: Zero calibration by pulling HD pin low.

raw_encoding.notes: CO2 concentration is 16-bit unsigned from response bytes 2 (high) and 3 (low).

bitfields.description: 32-bit detection range value (0~2000, 0~5000, or 0~10000 ppm). Byte4: bits 24-31, Byte5: bits 16-23, Byte6: bits 8-15, Byte7: bits 0-7.

bitfields.description: High byte of CO2 concentration value

timing_constraints.name: hd_pin_low_duration_for_zero_calibration
timing_constraints.notes: HD pin low level lasting for over 7s is effective

timing_constraints.name: stabilization_time_before_zero_calibration
timing_constraints.notes: Sensor must be stable at 400ppm for at least 20 minutes

inputs.name: high_byte
inputs.description: High byte of CO2 concentration from response byte 2

inputs.name: low_byte
inputs.description: Low byte of CO2 concentration from response byte 3

conversion_formulae.name: co2_pwm
conversion_formulae.notes: PWM-based CO2 concentration for 0-2000ppm range. Requires pulse width measurements TH and TL.

conversion_formulae.name: co2_analog
conversion_formulae.notes: Analog voltage output conversion. Default range 0.4V-2V. Detection range configurable.

integer_approximation_expression.expression: ((~(byte1 + byte2 + byte3 + byte4 + byte5 + byte6 + byte7)) + 1) & 255

error_conditions.name: checksum_mismatch
error_conditions.description: Response checksum does not match calculated checksum.
error_conditions.detection: Compare received checksum byte with computed checksum of bytes 1-7.
error_conditions.driver_action: Discard response and retry read operation.

error_conditions.name: response_command_byte_mismatch
error_conditions.description: Response command byte does not match expected command.
error_conditions.detection: Check that response byte 1 equals the sent command byte (e.g., 0x86).

power_states.name: active
power_states.description: Normal operating mode, sensor measuring CO2.

evidence_spans.snippet: Set serial port baud rate be 9600, data bit 8 bytes, stop bit 1byte, parity bit null.
0x79 ON/OFF Self-calibration function for zero point
Connect module's HD pin to low level(0V), lasting for 7 seconds at least.
Before calibrating the zero point, please ensure that the sensor is stable for more than 20 minutes at 400ppm ambient environment.
The calibration cycle is every 24 hours since the module is power on.
Default status is 'this function is on'.
Hd HD(zero point calibration, low level lasting for over 7s is effective)

requires_human: Analog output voltage range is configurable from 0V to 3V; default is 0.4V to 2V. Customization may require factory configuration.
Detection range must be set to one of 0~2000, 0~5000, or 0~10000 ppm. The formula for PWM output uses 2000ppm range; adjust if different range is used.
Self-calibration is enabled by default; turn off for greenhouse, farm, or refrigerator applications.
Zero point calibration assumes 400ppm CO2 environment; ensure sensor is stable for 20 minutes before calibration.
